**Do not merge yet — for review.** Live demo: `self-evolving/sepo-site-branch-demo` (being set up; see the session summary).

Lets the literature site live **inside an existing repository** as an orphan branch:

- `agent-implement.yml` / `agent-add-paper.yml`: `resolve-implementation-base` falls back to the `SEPO_SITE_BRANCH` repository variable (explicit `base_branch` input and the add-rubrics ref still take precedence) — so mention-driven literature work branches from and PRs into the site branch, while the agent trigger surface stays on the default branch (GitHub only fires `issue_comment`/`issues` workflows from there).
- `.skills/site-branch-install/SKILL.md`: the install procedure — orphan branch carrying the full site tree minus agent-routing workflows/prompts/issue templates (`.agent/` and `.github/actions/` stay: the branch's preview/deploy workflows run the runtime CLIs from the checked-out tree), canonical-deploy workflow rescoped to the branch, validation, `SEPO_SITE_BRANCH` wiring, dependabot `target-branch` note.
- README + skills README document the flow.

Known v1 simplification (stated in the skill): with the variable set, all `/implement` dispatches default to the site branch; host-project work needs an explicit `base_branch`. Label-based routing is the refinement path.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01KSJ1viQV4pp3hcWo9u5oPV

---

**Findings from the live demo** (`self-evolving/sepo-site-branch-demo`):

- End-to-end verified: agent layer on a Node-free Python host's `main`, orphan `literature` branch self-deploys via its own rescoped workflow → https://self-evolving-sepo-site-bran-literature-78f3ef.sepo.site — and `resolve-implementation-base` resolves `SEPO_SITE_BRANCH=literature` correctly (verified against the live repo).
- **Server-side follow-up:** the preview API rejects `canonical: true` when the OIDC ref isn't the default branch (403, `claim_ref: refs/heads/literature`). Branch sites currently publish as stable branch deployments; making a branch-installed site *canonical* needs a server-side allowance (e.g., a registered site branch per repo). The skill documents this.
- The demo's full mention→PR run needs provider secrets in the demo repo (org secrets don't propagate there); the routing chain is otherwise proven.
title: Site-branch install: SEPO_SITE_BRANCH routing + install skill
